mapper.select: SELECT tdm58_chck_appr_step_id AS chck_appr_step_id , tdm58_chck_org_id AS chck_org_id , tdm58_appr_seq AS appr_seq , tdm58_appr_emp_id AS appr_emp_id , emp00_kor_nm AS appr_emp_name , emp00_org_code_id AS appr_org_id , emp00_org_code_nm AS appr_org_name , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm58_appr_seq) || '차 승인자' AS appr_step_info FROM tdm58_chck_appr_step INNER JOIN tdm51_chck_org ON tdm51_chck_org_id = tdm58_chck_org_id INNER JOIN tdm50_chck_job ON ( tdm50_company_id = tdm51_company_id AND tdm50_check_ym = tdm51_check_ym ) INNER JOIN getPerson(tdm50_company_id, tdm50_start_date) ON emp00_person_id = tdm58_appr_emp_id WHERE tdm58_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId}
SELECT tdm51_company_id FROM tdm58_chck_appr_step INNER JOIN tdm51_chck_org ON tdm51_chck_org_id = tdm58_chck_org_id WHERE tdm58_chck_appr_step_id = #{chckApprStepId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm58_chck_appr_step ( tdm58_chck_appr_step_id, tdm58_chck_org_id, tdm58_appr_seq, tdm58_appr_emp_id, tdm58_upd_nm, tdm58_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{row.chckApprStepId}, #{row.chckOrgId}, #{row.apprSeq}, #{row.apprEmpId}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
